verdict.rationale: Bland's docs point to a Pathways API reference for creating and managing pathways programmatically and describe agents starting flows over a plain API call. Official CLI, MCP server and web SDK surfaces show the account is built to be driven by code. However, the pack contains no actual API reference content, such as endpoints, auth or rate limits, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so the depth of the public API is only implied. Missing for 10: the API reference content itself (endpoint and auth documentation), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: See the Pathways API reference to create and manage pathways programmatically.
the bot starts the flow over a plain API call
Manage your entire Bland account from the terminal: make calls, build and test pathways, configure phone numbers, and more.
The SDK handles secure authentication between your server and Bland, so your API key is never exposed to the browser.
